reasons: Genuine deviation: p0149 imposes a blanket bar on Licensee assignment with no affiliate/M&A carve-out and no reasonableness standard, and p0134 makes any Change of Control of Licensee an automatic termination absent Licensor consent (with broad deemed-reasonable refusal grounds) — this fails the fallback (mutual successor assignment on notice, consent not unreasonably withheld) and matches the rule's walk-away description.

Redline reaches the playbook position: adds the affiliate/successor carve-out without consent, subjects other Licensee assignments to consent not unreasonably withheld, restricts Licensor assignment (never to a Licensee competitor), and removes the change-of-control consent/termination trigger while preserving the Change of Control definition stub and the successors-and-assigns sentence.

High changed-character ratios on both paragraphs are justified here: the assignment prohibition and the automatic-termination sentence cannot be fixed by insertion alone; no unnecessary commercial terms were altered.

Comment is accurate, concise, cites the playbook position (walk-away characterisation of blanket bar plus CoC termination) and offers the mutual notice-only successor fallback; the ROFR point is correctly noted rather than double-flagged.
